name: Coyerti
description: Coyerti was a planet in the Mid Rim, and was the home of the Coyerti species. Due to its rich plant and animal life, it served as a military research outpost for biological weapons. It was the location of a conflict between the Rebel Alliance and the Galactic Empire during the Galactic Civil War.
